questions.cardText:
[Computer Science] What does “HTML” stand for?
A. HyperText Markup Language
B. HyperText Machine Language
C. HyperText and links Markup Language
Answer: A.
questions.en: What does the abbreviation “HTML” stand for?

timeline.labelEn: Tim Berners-Lee specifies HTML and writes the first web browser and server software at CERN
timeline.labelDe: Tim Berners-Lee spezifiziert HTML und schreibt am CERN die erste Webbrowser- und Serversoftware

questions.cardText:
[Psychology] What is the “first night effect” in psychology?
A. Difficulty sleeping the first night in a new environment
B. Increased creativity on the first night in a new environment
C. Enhanced memory recall on the first night in a new environment
Answer: A. Recent studies suggest that the effect is because one hemisphere of the brain remains more alert as a protective measure in a new environment. This phenomenon is so well-recognized that sleep study researchers often exclude the first night’s data.
questions.de: Wie heißt das Phänomen, wegen dem Schlafforscher die erste Nacht oft verwerfen: In ungewohnter Umgebung schläft man schlecht, weil eine Hirnhälfte wachsamer bleibt?
questions.en: What is the name of the phenomenon, so well known that sleep researchers often discard the first recording, in which people sleep poorly in a new environment because one brain hemisphere stays more alert?

timeline.labelEn: Agnew, Webb and Williams describe the “first night effect” in an EEG study of sleep
timeline.labelDe: Agnew, Webb und Williams beschreiben den „Erste-Nacht-Effekt“ in einer EEG-Schlafstudie

source.title: Why It’s Hard To Fall Asleep Somewhere New – Neuroscience News

questions.notes: Card answer confirmed; the 'one hemisphere stays alert' finding is Tamaki et al., Current Biology, 21 April 2016. Term from Agnew, Webb & Williams (Psychophysiology, 1966), which also notes researchers exclude first-night recordings.
